# First-Agent — llms.txt

> Locally orchestrated, mixed-tier LLM coding agent for single power-user. Filesystem-canonical knowledge (Markdown + YAML frontmatter); read-side scales lazily from grep to BM25. Written in Python; target codebases the agent reads can be anything.

> This file is an index for LLM agents that want to ingest project documentation in one fetch. Paths relative to repo root.

> Tiered layout. §MUST READ FIRST is smallest path that bootstraps session (5 files, in order). §TASK ROUTING points task-types at right primary entrypoint.
§FORMAL SUBSTRATE replaces §BY-DEMAND INDEX full file list — use Blackboard query + instant grep for artifact search.

## § MUST READ FIRST

Five files cover ~90% of session-start context. Read in order:

1. AGENTS.md — universal session loadout: repo navigation, style, §Pre-flight checklist, §Context-budget discipline, cross-project anti-patterns, §Loadable skills, query routing, §Querying Artifacts — Use Blackboard and Instant Grep First
2. knowledge/project-overview.md — §1.1 four-pillar goal; §1.2 minimalism-first; §1.2.5 compliance-by-construction; §1.2.6 Substrate Formality; §1.2.7 Pair over Autonomy
3. worklogs/HANDOFF.md — ongoing tasks, planned work - updated 2026-08-25
4. knowledge/adr/DIGEST.md — one-paragraph cheat-sheet per ADR
5. knowledge/reference.md — canonical definitions, features, project architecture

## § TASK ROUTING

Task type → primary entrypoint, then secondary:

- Inner-loop / tool-registry contract → knowledge/adr/ADR-7-inner-loop-tool-registry.md
- New ADR or amendment → knowledge/adr/ADR-template.md + knowledge/skills/pr-creation/SKILL.md
- New module / Phase M PR → knowledge/research/memory-architecture-design-2026-04-26.md §9 roadmap + knowledge/adr/DIGEST.md
- Research-briefing note → knowledge/prompts/research-briefing.md, then knowledge/research/_template.md
- Edit exploration_log.md → schema in knowledge/README.md §trace/
- Any PR → knowledge/skills/pr-creation/SKILL.md (5-intent classifier + PR Checklist)
- Relocate / rename a module? → grep knowledge/anti-patterns/README.md first; AP-001 is canonical path-bypass trap
- Deploy / operate / administer the AIO → knowledge/instructions/README.md (human start-here index); live CI/security/governance execution → knowledge/instructions/03-live-server-ci-governance-plan-ru.md
- Move / prune a doc? → knowledge/skills/doc-maintenance/SKILL.md §When moving or pruning a doc (fix every reference in same PR; no dangling links)
- Specific number / date / quote → primary source from `source:` frontmatter, NOT a summary. Per AGENTS.md §Query Routing

# STOP HERE UNLESS SPECIFICALLY ROUTED — For full file list, use formal substrate below.

## § FORMAL SUBSTRATE — Blackboard + Instant Grep (Replaces BY-DEMAND INDEX)

**BY-DEMAND INDEX full file list is deprecated as of ADR-14/15 (2026-07-11). Use formal substrate for artifact search:**

**Session data authority:** `session.db` is per-run SQLite authority (3 tables: event_log, blackboard, session_meta). JSONL files are best-effort mirrors — if they disagree with session.db, session.db wins. Full schema: knowledge/reference.md §Session Data Layout.

- **For finding artifacts by TYPE / TITLE / REVISION:** `fs_blackboard_query(type="skill", key="<substring in title/path>")` → typed, content-hashed rows (id, type, title, path, timestamps) with lazy index on first call. `key` matches metadata (title/path/hash), **NOT file body**. `type="file_version"` returns `pre/post-<uuid>` mutation snapshots.
- **For body-content substring search (code OR docs) — S14b.1 unified `fs_search`:** `fs_search(query="…", output_mode="files", limit=10)` → FTS5 BM25 + trigram, <50ms after first-call lazy index, returns paths with match_count + a short first-match snippet. Add `glob="*.py"` for path/pattern filtering, `include_tests=false` to exclude tests/, `path="src/…"` to scope to a subdir. DEFAULT to `output_mode="files"`. Escalate to `output_mode="regions"` (contiguous snippets with context) when you want inline code without a follow-up read_file, or `output_mode="matches"` for exact line numbers (rare, e.g. to target an edit_file). Use `output_mode="counts"` for a quick distribution overview. Body retrieval of a known path → `fs_read_file(path=…)`. Hard caps: `limit` clamped to 1–50, `context_lines` clamped to 0–5; responses capped at ~30KB. Do NOT invoke `grep`/`rg`/`find`/`ag`/`ack` via bash for discovery — they are not token-bounded and historically caused 124-step timeouts.
- **For call-graph navigation (S16) — `fs_reach`:** `fs_reach(symbol="_parse_bool", direction="up", depth=2)` → resolves the symbol by exact suffix (or `§anchor-id`), BFS-walks callers (up) / callees (down) / both over the lazily-built `.fa/structural.db`. Params: `direction` (`up|down|both`, default both), `depth` (default 2, max 5), `limit` (default 20, max 50), `kind` (`function|method|doc_anchor`), `include_tests` (default false — test paths filtered at query time). Python-only in v1: non-Python workspaces return a structured `status:"unavailable"`; unresolved callees are reported honestly as `<unresolved:…>` — v1 resolution is in-file only, no cross-file edges.
- **Code anchors (S17):** contract/invariant points carry `# §<stable-id>: <description>` comments (sparse: ≤1 per ~200 lines; stable: never rename a referenced id). Resolve via `fs_reach(symbol="§<id>")`, find via `fs_search(query="§<id>")`. Seed anchors exist in `blackboard.py`, `state.py`, `runtime_limits.py`, `loop.py`, `fts_index.py`, `structural_index.py`.
- **For full file list:** Query blackboard: `fs_blackboard_query(type="research")` returns matching blackboard entries with path, content_hash, title. For plain path globbing use `fs_search(query=" ", glob="knowledge/**/*.md")` but prefer blackboard. Artifact rows are indexed lazily on first artifact-typed query (content-hash-addressed, append-only). Blackboard is the single entry point for typed artifacts and mutation history.

- **For bootstrap, you already have MUST READ FIRST 5 files. For anything else, query.**

- **For writing files:** Declare read_set (files surfaced via fs_search or read via fs_read_file), write_set (file written), assumptions (base commit `git rev-parse HEAD`, llms.txt hash), version_dependencies. Blackboard checks conflict via `detect_conflict()` before allowing write. If conflict (read_set overlaps write_set of concurrent entry), return structured ToolResult.fail code "conflict_detected" with details, not silent overwrite.

- **Blackboard location:** `.fa/blackboard/blackboard.jsonl` append-only, never overwritten, Control Unit managing reads/writes, each entry stamped with toolchain digests, provider schema versions, content hashes for reproducibility (as MACOG blackboard). Queryable, detects conflict, metrics merge success/belief divergence |Bk-Sk|.

- **Instant Grep location:** `.fa/fts.db` FTS5 trigram index, DELETE then INSERT + mtime tracking + stale cleanup + fallback porter WARNING, returns paths not content <50ms substring search "auth"→"AuthMiddleware", token efficient, 0 external deps sqlite3 stdlib, excludes .fa/, node_modules/, .venv/, __pycache__/, .git/, sessions/.

**BACKLOG/PR-NOTES canonical moves (b_full):**
- `knowledge/BACKLOG.md` → `worklogs/BACKLOG.md` (56 entries, merged I-34..I-56). Old file now pointer stub.
- `knowledge/pr-notes/` (25 files, stale `../research/` links) → `worklogs/pr-notes/` (30 files canonical). Old dir backed up to `worklogs/archive/knowledge-pr-notes-20260825/` and replaced with `README.md` pointer.

**Why deprecated:**
- Maintenance burden: When adding/removing file under docs/ or knowledge/, previously had to update llms.txt BY-DEMAND INDEX manually per doc-maintenance skill. Now BY-DEMAND INDEX auto-generated from blackboard or not needed — query blackboard instead.
- Token waste: Previously, agent might read entire BY-DEMAND INDEX full list (hundreds of files) to find one file, token heavy. Now query returns 10 paths <50ms.
- Formal substrate has content_hash, read_set/write_set, version_dependencies for reproducibility, llms.txt does not.

**What to use instead:**
- `fs_blackboard_query(type="research")` → all research-note blackboard entries
- `fs_blackboard_query(type="adr")` → all ADR blackboard entries
- `fs_blackboard_query(type="skill", key="api")` → skill entries whose title/path contains "api" (metadata match, not body)
- `fs_search(query="auth", output_mode="files", limit=10)` → paths of files (code or docs) whose body contains "auth" (ranked BM25, snippet included)
- `fs_search(query=" ", glob="knowledge/**/*.md")` → glob-style path listing, but prefer blackboard query for typed artifacts

**Old full list removed to reduce maintenance burden. If you need old list for backwards compatibility, run:**

```bash
# Via blackboard
python3 -c "from fa.blackboard.blackboard import Blackboard; bb=Blackboard(Path('.fa/blackboard')); print(bb.query(type='research'))"

# Via glob
find knowledge -type f -name "*.md" | sort
```

**Future:** `fa generate-llms-txt` tool will auto-generate BY-DEMAND INDEX from blackboard, so manual update not needed.
